title: Symbols from a map file
description:
Turn crash addresses into function names with a linker map file.

```
module base 0x140000000
0x140001234 -> Game::update + 0x34
0x1400020F0 -> Renderer::draw + 0x10
0x150000000 -> outside the module
```
hints: `<sstream>` gives streams over strings. `std::istringstream in{ text };` reads from a string exactly like `std::cin` (`in >> word >> number`, or `std::getline(in, line)` for one line at a time), and its condition is false once a read fails. `std::ostringstream out; out << "x " << 5; out.str()` builds a string the way `std::cout` prints.
`std::upper_bound` then step back one finds the nearest symbol at or below.
requirements: Parse lines of `address name` (a simplified map file) and sort them.
Subtract the base the module was loaded at and add the preferred base before looking up.
Print `name + offset` for the nearest symbol below the address.
stretch: Use `SymFromAddr` with a PDB on Windows and compare.
